Name: Boots recolor - all brown (Content Patcher)
Author: cathtail
Description:
I made this mod 'cause I was tired of Space Boots color and I think that brown fits with everything. Especially when you're a farmer. :P

[size=5][u][font=Trebuchet MS]How to install:[/font]

[/u][/size][i]Content Patcher:[/i]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Make sure you have downloaded and installed the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]﻿﻿﻿﻿
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI. Enjoy!
[/list]

Remember to always backup your files! 

Thank you <3
